title: Oozy, Cheesy Tomato Gnocchi Bake
description: Gnocchi simmered in a garlicky tomato and basil sauce, topped with mozzarella, Cheddar and Parmesan and baked until bubbling.
ingredients: 1 tsp dried oregano (plus extra for sprinkling)
10 basil leaves, torn (plus extra to serve)
steps: In a medium-sized ovenproof pot, fry onion in cooking spray for 3–4 minutes until softened.
Add garlic; stir-fry gently 1 minute. Add passata; stir through. Add oregano and basil; season with ¼ tsp each salt and pepper.
Stir gnocchi through sauce; increase heat to a rapid simmer.
Remove from heat; scatter torn mozzarella evenly over top; sprinkle over Cheddar and Parmesan. Sprinkle with more oregano and pepper.
Bake in oven for 15 minutes until cheese is golden and bubbling. Scatter with basil leaves to serve.
notes: Add halved cherry tomatoes or chopped red pepper after the onion for extra vegetables.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
